groups.name: and · but · so · because · or
groups.tip: and thêm ý; but đối lập; so chỉ kết quả (đứng trước kết quả); because chỉ nguyên nhân (đứng trước nguyên nhân); or đưa lựa chọn.

mcq.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
mcq.w: "đi ngủ sớm" là kết quả của "mệt" → so + kết quả.

mcq.q: I went to bed early ___ I was tired.
mcq.w: "mệt" là nguyên nhân → because + nguyên nhân.

mcq.q: The phone is cheap, ___ the battery is very weak.
mcq.w: Hai ý trái ngược (rẻ ↔ pin yếu) → but.

mcq.q: Would you like tea ___ coffee?
mcq.w: Hỏi chọn một trong hai → or.

mcq.q: She likes reading ___ listening to music.
mcq.w: Thêm một sở thích nữa, cùng chiều → and.

mcq.q: It started to rain, ___ we stayed at home.
mcq.w: Ở nhà là kết quả của trời mưa → so.

mcq.q: We stayed at home ___ it was raining.
mcq.w: Trời mưa là lý do → because.

mcq.q: He studied hard, ___ he failed the test.
mcq.w: Học chăm mà vẫn trượt — kết quả trái mong đợi → but.

mcq.q: You can pay by card ___ in cash.
mcq.w: Hai cách trả, chọn một → or.

mcq.q: My brother is tall ___ thin.
mcq.w: Hai đặc điểm cùng được nêu thêm → and.

mcq.q: I didn't have breakfast, ___ I am very hungry now.
mcq.w: Đói là kết quả → so.

mcq.q: I am very hungry ___ I didn't have breakfast.
mcq.w: Không ăn sáng là nguyên nhân → because.

mcq.q: The film was long, ___ it was very interesting.
mcq.w: Dài (điểm trừ) nhưng hay (điểm cộng) → but.

mcq.q: Hurry up, ___ we will miss the bus.
mcq.w: "Nhanh lên, nếu không thì…" → or (= otherwise).

groups.name: first · then · after that · finally · also · too
groups.tip: first / then / after that / finally kể các bước theo thứ tự; also đứng trước động từ thường (I also like…), too đứng cuối câu.

mcq.q: ___, wash the rice. Then put it in the cooker.
mcq.w: Bước đầu tiên → First.

mcq.q: I went to the bank. ___, I bought some fruit at the market.
mcq.w: Việc xảy ra tiếp theo → After that.

mcq.q: We walked for three hours. ___, we reached the top of the mountain.
mcq.w: Cuối cùng (sau một quá trình dài) → Finally.

mcq.q: I like football. My brother likes it ___.
mcq.w: too đứng cuối câu.

mcq.q: I like football. My brother ___ likes it.
mcq.w: also đứng trước động từ thường (also likes).

mcq.q: She speaks English. She can ___ speak a little Chinese.
mcq.w: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu (can) → can also + V.

mcq.q: Open the app. ___ choose your language.
mcq.w: Bước kế tiếp → Then.

mcq.q: He finished his homework and ___ he watched TV.
mcq.w: Việc làm sau → then.

groups.name: Nối hai câu
groups.tip: Khi nối bằng because / so / but thì bỏ dấu chấm và viết thành một câu.

en: It was cold, so I wore a jacket.
It was cold so I wore a jacket.
join.w: so đứng trước kết quả (mặc áo khoác).

en: I wore a jacket because it was cold.
join.w: because đứng trước nguyên nhân (trời lạnh).

en: The hotel was old, but it was very clean.
The hotel was old but it was very clean.
I missed the bus, so I was late for class.
I missed the bus so I was late for class.
Lan is happy because she passed the exam.
First, I had breakfast, and then I went to school.
First, I had breakfast. Then I went to school.
First I had breakfast and then I went to school.

fix.wrong: I am tired so because I worked late.
en: I am tired because I worked late.
I worked late, so I am tired.
fix.w: Không dùng so và because cùng lúc: chọn một.

fix.wrong: Because it rained. We stayed at home.
en: Because it rained, we stayed at home.
We stayed at home because it rained.
fix.w: "Because it rained" chưa phải câu hoàn chỉnh → nối với mệnh đề chính.

fix.wrong: Although it was late, but he kept working.
en: Although it was late, he kept working.
It was late, but he kept working.
fix.w: Although và but không đi cùng nhau.

fix.wrong: I like coffee, I also like tea too.
en: I like coffee, and I also like tea.
I like coffee, and I like tea too.
I like coffee. I also like tea.
fix.w: Dùng also hoặc too, không dùng cả hai; nối hai mệnh đề cần and.

fix.wrong: She also is a good singer.
en: She is also a good singer.
fix.w: also đứng sau to be (is also).

fix.wrong: He can play the guitar and also he can sing.
en: He can play the guitar, and he can also sing.
He can play the guitar and he can also sing.
fix.w: also đứng sau động từ khuyết thiếu: can also sing.

groups.name: in addition · moreover · furthermore · additionally · besides · as well as
groups.tip: Thêm một ý cùng chiều. In addition / Moreover / Furthermore / Additionally / Besides đứng đầu câu + dấu phẩy. as well as + danh từ / V-ing.

mcq.q: The flat is near my office. ___, the rent is quite low.
mcq.w: Thêm một ưu điểm nữa → Moreover.

mcq.q: Cycling is good for your health. ___, it does not pollute the air.
mcq.w: Thêm một lợi ích → In addition.

mcq.q: The course is expensive. ___, the classes are always crowded.
mcq.w: Thêm một điểm trừ nữa (cùng chiều tiêu cực) → Furthermore.

mcq.q: She speaks English ___ French.
mcq.w: as well as + danh từ, nối trong câu.

mcq.q: ___, the app lets you study offline.
mcq.w: Thêm tính năng → Additionally, đầu câu + dấu phẩy.

mcq.q: I don't want to go out; ___, it is raining.
mcq.w: besides = hơn nữa (thêm một lý do), hay dùng khi nói.

mcq.q: Online learning saves time. ___, students can study at their own pace.
mcq.w: What is more = Moreover (thêm ý).

mcq.q: He plays the piano ___ the guitar.
mcq.w: Nối hai danh từ trong cùng câu → as well as.

mcq.q: Exercise improves your mood. It ___ helps you sleep better.
mcq.w: Cách thêm ý đơn giản nhất: It also + V.

mcq.q: Public transport is cheap. ___, it is better for the environment.
mcq.w: On top of that = thêm vào đó (thân mật hơn).

groups.name: however · although · even though · while
groups.tip: However + dấu phẩy, đầu câu thứ hai. Although / Even though + mệnh đề (S + V), không dùng cùng but.

mcq.q: The test was difficult. ___, most students passed.
mcq.w: Ý sau trái với mong đợi → However.

mcq.q: ___ the test was difficult, most students passed.
mcq.w: Đứng đầu câu ghép, theo sau là mệnh đề → Although.

mcq.q: I enjoyed the trip, ___ the weather was bad.
mcq.w: even though + mệnh đề, nhấn mạnh hơn although.

mcq.q: The city is noisy. ___, I love living here.
mcq.w: Ồn mà vẫn thích → However.

mcq.q: ___ she was tired, she finished her homework.
mcq.w: Although + S + V.

mcq.q: Some people like living in cities, ___ others prefer the countryside.
mcq.w: while nối hai ý đối lập trong cùng câu.

mcq.q: The phone has a great camera. The battery, ___, is disappointing.
mcq.w: however có thể đứng giữa câu, giữa hai dấu phẩy.

mcq.q: He is rich. ___, he is not happy.
mcq.w: Giàu mà không hạnh phúc → đối lập.

groups.name: therefore · as a result · so · that's why
groups.tip: Chỉ kết quả. Therefore / As a result đứng đầu câu sau + dấu phẩy; so nối trong câu.

mcq.q: Prices went up. ___, people bought less.
mcq.w: Mua ít hơn là kết quả của giá tăng → As a result.

mcq.q: The road was flooded. ___, the school was closed.
mcq.w: Kết quả → Therefore.

mcq.q: I forgot my password, ___ I couldn't log in.
mcq.w: Nối trong câu bằng dấu phẩy → so (Therefore cần câu mới hoặc dấu chấm phẩy).

mcq.q: He practised every day. ___ he speaks English so well.
mcq.w: That's why = vì thế mà (nói).

mcq.q: The factory closed. ___, many people lost their jobs.
mcq.w: Mất việc là kết quả của nhà máy đóng cửa.

mcq.q: Fast food is cheap and quick. ___, many students eat it every day.
mcq.w: Rẻ và nhanh → nên nhiều người ăn → Therefore.

groups.name: for example · for instance · such as
groups.tip: For example / For instance + câu hoàn chỉnh (đầu câu + dấu phẩy). such as + danh từ, ngay sau danh từ được ví dụ.

mcq.q: Many fruits, ___ oranges and lemons, contain vitamin C.
mcq.w: Liệt kê danh từ ngay sau "fruits" → such as.

mcq.q: Technology helps students. ___, they can watch lessons online.
mcq.w: Đưa ví dụ bằng một câu → For example.

mcq.q: Some jobs are dangerous. ___, firefighters risk their lives every day.
mcq.w: For instance = For example.

mcq.q: I love outdoor sports ___ hiking and cycling.
mcq.w: such as + danh từ / V-ing.

mcq.q: You can save money in small ways. ___, you can cook at home instead of eating out.
mcq.w: Ví dụ là một câu → For example.

mcq.q: Big cities ___ Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City have serious traffic problems.
mcq.w: such as đứng ngay sau danh từ.

groups.name: Nối câu cấp 2
groups.tip: Chú ý dấu câu: Moreover, / However, / Therefore, / For example, đứng đầu câu kèm dấu phẩy.

en: The restaurant is cheap. Moreover, the food is delicious.
The restaurant is cheap; moreover, the food is delicious.
join.w: Moreover thêm ý, đầu câu + dấu phẩy.

en: The hotel was cheap. However, the room was very comfortable.
The hotel was cheap; however, the room was very comfortable.
join.w: Rẻ mà phòng lại rất thoải mái — trái mong đợi → However.

en: Although he was ill, he went to work.
He went to work although he was ill.
join.w: Although + mệnh đề, không thêm but.

en: It rained heavily. As a result, the match was cancelled.
It rained heavily; as a result, the match was cancelled.
join.w: As a result chỉ kết quả.

join.b: Tigers and elephants are hunted for money.
en: Many animals are in danger. For example, tigers and elephants are hunted for money.
join.w: For example + một câu ví dụ.

en: I enjoy water sports such as swimming and surfing.
join.w: such as + danh từ / V-ing ngay sau "water sports".

join.b: We missed the beginning of the film.
en: The bus was late. Therefore, we missed the beginning of the film.
The bus was late; therefore, we missed the beginning of the film.
She speaks Japanese as well as Korean.
She speaks Korean as well as Japanese.
Living alone is lonely. In addition, it is expensive.
Living alone is lonely; in addition, it is expensive.
join.w: In addition thêm một điểm trừ nữa.

en: Even though the phone is old, it still works well.
The phone still works well even though it is old.

fix.wrong: However the weather was bad, we went out.
en: The weather was bad. However, we went out.
Although the weather was bad, we went out.
fix.w: However không nối hai mệnh đề trong một câu như although; dùng Although, hoặc tách câu.

fix.wrong: Although she was busy, but she helped me.
en: Although she was busy, she helped me.
She was busy, but she helped me.
fix.w: Although và but không đi cùng nhau.

fix.wrong: I like many sports, such as, football and tennis.
en: I like many sports, such as football and tennis.
fix.w: Không đặt dấu phẩy ngay sau such as.

fix.wrong: Such as, many students work part-time.
en: For example, many students work part-time.
fix.w: Đầu câu đưa ví dụ dùng For example, không dùng Such as.

fix.wrong: It was late, therefore we took a taxi.
en: It was late, so we took a taxi.
It was late. Therefore, we took a taxi.
It was late; therefore, we took a taxi.
fix.w: Therefore không nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy: dùng so, hoặc tách câu / dấu chấm phẩy.

fix.wrong: Moreover the price is high.
en: Moreover, the price is high.
fix.w: Sau Moreover đầu câu cần dấu phẩy.

fix.wrong: In addition to, the hotel has a pool.
en: In addition, the hotel has a pool.
In addition to a gym, the hotel has a pool.
fix.w: In addition, (đầu câu) khác in addition to + danh từ.

fix.wrong: He is clever, however he is lazy.
en: He is clever. However, he is lazy.
He is clever, but he is lazy.
He is clever; however, he is lazy.
fix.w: However không nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy: dùng but, hoặc tách câu.

groups.name: despite · in spite of · although
groups.tip: despite / in spite of + danh từ / V-ing / the fact that; although + mệnh đề (S + V).

mcq.q: ___ the rain, we went for a walk.
mcq.w: "the rain" là danh từ → Despite.

mcq.q: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk.
mcq.w: "it was raining" là mệnh đề → Although.

mcq.q: In spite of ___ hard, he failed the exam.
mcq.w: in spite of + V-ing.

mcq.q: She went to work ___ feeling ill.
mcq.w: Sau chỗ trống là V-ing → despite.

mcq.q: ___ his age, my grandfather still runs every morning.
mcq.w: "his age" là cụm danh từ → Despite.

mcq.q: We enjoyed the holiday ___ the hotel was not very good.
mcq.w: Mệnh đề theo sau → although.

mcq.q: Despite ___ he was tired, he kept working.
mcq.w: despite the fact that + mệnh đề.

mcq.q: The team won ___ playing with ten men.
mcq.w: despite + V-ing.

groups.name: because of · due to · because · since
groups.tip: because of / due to + danh từ / cụm danh từ; because / since + mệnh đề.

mcq.q: The flight was delayed ___ the storm.
mcq.w: "the storm" là danh từ → because of.

mcq.q: The flight was delayed ___ there was a storm.
mcq.w: Mệnh đề → because.

mcq.q: Many people get sick ___ air pollution.
mcq.w: due to + danh từ.

mcq.q: ___ it was a public holiday, the banks were closed.
mcq.w: Since (= because) + mệnh đề, hay đứng đầu câu.

mcq.q: He couldn't sleep ___ the noise from the street.
mcq.w: + cụm danh từ → because of.

mcq.q: The match was cancelled ___ heavy rain.
mcq.w: + danh từ → due to.

mcq.q: ___ the high price, few people bought the new phone.
mcq.w: + cụm danh từ → Because of.

mcq.q: She stayed at home ___ she had a headache.
mcq.w: as (= because) + mệnh đề.

groups.name: whereas · while · on the other hand · in contrast · similarly
groups.tip: whereas / while nối hai mệnh đề trái ngược trong một câu. On the other hand / In contrast đầu câu sau + dấu phẩy. Similarly = tương tự.

mcq.q: My sister loves cats, ___ I prefer dogs.
mcq.w: So sánh hai người trái ngược trong một câu → whereas.

mcq.q: Living in the city is exciting. ___, it can be stressful.
mcq.w: Mặt khác (trái chiều) → On the other hand.

mcq.q: In Vietnam, people drive on the right. ___, people in Japan drive on the left.
mcq.w: Đối lập hai nơi → In contrast.

mcq.q: Buses are cheap, ___ taxis are expensive.
mcq.w: while = whereas.

mcq.q: Running is good for the heart. ___, swimming makes the heart stronger.
mcq.w: Hai ý giống nhau → Similarly.

mcq.q: Some students study best in the morning, ___ others work better at night.
mcq.w: Hai nhóm trái ngược → whereas.

mcq.q: The job pays well. ___, the hours are very long.
mcq.w: Điểm cộng rồi điểm trừ → On the other hand.

mcq.q: Men in my family are tall. ___, the women are quite short.
mcq.w: Đối lập → In contrast.

groups.name: instead · instead of · rather than
groups.tip: instead of / rather than + danh từ / V-ing (thay vì). Instead đứng cuối câu hoặc đầu câu + dấu phẩy (thay vào đó).

mcq.q: Let's walk ___ taking a taxi.
mcq.w: + V-ing → instead of.

mcq.q: I didn't go to the party. I stayed at home ___.
mcq.w: Cuối câu, không có danh từ theo sau → instead.

mcq.q: She drinks tea ___ coffee.
mcq.w: + danh từ → instead of.

mcq.q: He decided to study abroad ___ working for his father.
mcq.w: rather than + V-ing / danh từ.

mcq.q: We couldn't go to the beach. ___, we visited a museum.
mcq.w: Đầu câu + dấu phẩy, không có danh từ theo sau → Instead.

mcq.q: You should use the stairs ___ the lift.
mcq.w: + danh từ → instead of.

groups.name: unless · otherwise · as long as · in case
groups.tip: unless = if … not; otherwise = nếu không thì (đầu câu sau / sau dấu chấm phẩy); as long as = miễn là; in case = phòng khi.

mcq.q: You will fail the exam ___ you study harder.
mcq.w: "trừ khi" = if … not → unless.

mcq.q: Hurry up. ___, we will miss the train.
mcq.w: "Nếu không thì" → Otherwise.

mcq.q: You can borrow my bike ___ you bring it back tomorrow.
mcq.w: "miễn là" → as long as.

mcq.q: Take an umbrella ___ it rains.
mcq.w: "phòng khi" → in case.

mcq.q: I won't go ___ you come with me.
mcq.w: Không đi trừ khi bạn đi cùng → unless.

mcq.q: Save your work every ten minutes; ___, you may lose it.
mcq.w: otherwise sau dấu chấm phẩy.

groups.name: Nối câu cấp 3
groups.tip: Chọn đúng dạng: danh từ / V-ing (despite, because of, instead of) hay mệnh đề (although, because).

en: Despite the cold, we went swimming.
We went swimming despite the cold.
Despite the fact that it was very cold, we went swimming.
We went swimming despite the cold weather.
join.w: despite + danh từ (the cold) hoặc the fact that + mệnh đề.

en: The train was late because of a technical problem.
I watched a film instead of studying.
My father likes classical music, whereas my mother likes pop music.
My father likes classical music whereas my mother likes pop music.
join.w: whereas nối hai ý trái ngược.

en: You won't improve unless you practise every day.
You won't improve unless you practice every day.

join.a: He has a lot of money.
join.b: He lives in a small flat.
en: In spite of having a lot of money, he lives in a small flat.
He lives in a small flat in spite of having a lot of money.
In spite of his money, he lives in a small flat.
join.w: in spite of + V-ing / danh từ.

en: Many accidents happened due to the icy roads.
Due to the icy roads, many accidents happened.
Write your password down in case you forget it.
Leave now. Otherwise, you will be late.
Leave now; otherwise, you will be late.
Leave now, otherwise you will be late.

join.b: The countryside offers a quieter life.
en: Cities offer more jobs. On the other hand, the countryside offers a quieter life.
Cities offer more jobs; on the other hand, the countryside offers a quieter life.
join.w: On the other hand đầu câu sau.

en: You can use my laptop as long as you are careful with it.

join.b: We did not wait for the lift.
en: We took the stairs rather than wait for the lift.
We took the stairs rather than waiting for the lift.
join.w: rather than + V nguyên mẫu / V-ing.

fix.wrong: Despite it was raining, we played football.
en: Although it was raining, we played football.
Despite the rain, we played football.
Despite the fact that it was raining, we played football.
fix.w: despite không đi với mệnh đề: dùng although hoặc despite + danh từ.

fix.wrong: Although the bad weather, the plane took off.
en: Despite the bad weather, the plane took off.
Although the weather was bad, the plane took off.
fix.w: although cần mệnh đề; với danh từ dùng despite.

fix.wrong: He was late because of he missed the bus.
en: He was late because he missed the bus.
He was late because of missing the bus.
fix.w: because + mệnh đề; because of + danh từ / V-ing.

fix.wrong: The game was cancelled because the rain.
en: The game was cancelled because of the rain.
The game was cancelled due to the rain.
The game was cancelled because it rained.
fix.w: Trước danh từ cần because of / due to.

fix.wrong: I will stay at home instead go out.
en: I will stay at home instead of going out.
I will stay at home rather than go out.
fix.w: instead of + V-ing.

fix.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will be late.
en: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
If you don't hurry, you will be late.
fix.w: unless đã mang nghĩa phủ định, không thêm don't.

fix.wrong: In spite of he was tired, he finished the race.
en: In spite of being tired, he finished the race.
Although he was tired, he finished the race.
In spite of the fact that he was tired, he finished the race.
fix.w: in spite of + V-ing / danh từ, không + mệnh đề.

fix.wrong: My brother is shy, whereas my sister is shy too.
en: My brother is shy, and my sister is shy too.
My brother is shy. Similarly, my sister is shy.
My brother is shy, whereas my sister is outgoing.
fix.w: whereas chỉ dùng cho hai ý trái ngược.

fix.wrong: Bring a jacket in case it will be cold.
en: Bring a jacket in case it is cold.
Bring a jacket in case it gets cold.
fix.w: Sau in case dùng hiện tại đơn cho tương lai.

fix.wrong: Instead going by car, we cycled.
en: Instead of going by car, we cycled.
fix.w: instead of + V-ing.

groups.name: firstly · secondly · finally · in conclusion · to sum up
groups.tip: Sắp xếp bài viết: Firstly / Secondly / Finally mở các ý chính; In conclusion / To sum up mở đoạn kết. Không dùng "At last" để liệt kê ý cuối (at last = cuối cùng thì, sau khi chờ đợi).

mcq.q: ___, working from home saves time because there is no need to commute.
mcq.w: Mở ý thứ nhất → Firstly.

mcq.q: ___, people who work from home can spend more time with their families.
mcq.w: Ý thứ hai → Secondly.

mcq.q: ___, I believe that the advantages of online learning outweigh the disadvantages.
mcq.w: Đoạn kết → In conclusion.

mcq.q: The bus was two hours late. When it ___ arrived, everyone cheered.
mcq.w: "Cuối cùng thì (sau khi chờ)" → finally; lastly / in conclusion dùng để liệt kê / kết bài.

mcq.q: ___, both governments and individuals have a role to play in protecting the environment.
mcq.w: Tóm lại → To sum up.

mcq.q: ___, and most importantly, exercise improves mental health.
mcq.w: Ý cuối trong danh sách → Finally / Lastly.

groups.name: nevertheless · nonetheless · even so · admittedly
groups.tip: Nevertheless / Nonetheless / Even so = tuy vậy (trang trọng hơn however), đầu câu + dấu phẩy. Admittedly = phải thừa nhận rằng (nhượng bộ trước khi phản bác).

mcq.q: Online courses are convenient. ___, they require a lot of self-discipline.
mcq.w: Thừa nhận ưu điểm rồi nêu hạn chế → Nevertheless.

mcq.q: ___, public transport is not always comfortable. However, it is much cheaper than driving.
mcq.w: Nhượng bộ trước rồi phản bác bằng However → Admittedly.

mcq.q: The plan was risky. ___, the company decided to try it.
mcq.w: Nonetheless = Nevertheless.

mcq.q: The hotel was far from the centre. ___, we enjoyed our stay.
mcq.w: Even so = dù vậy.

mcq.q: Tourism brings money to local people. ___, it can damage the environment.
mcq.w: Mặt trái → Nevertheless.

groups.name: consequently · thus · hence · this means that · this leads to
groups.tip: Chỉ kết quả, trang trọng. Consequently / Thus đầu câu + dấu phẩy; This means that + mệnh đề; This leads to + danh từ.

mcq.q: Many young people move to cities. ___, rural areas are losing their workforce.
mcq.w: Kết quả → Consequently.

mcq.q: Children spend hours on screens. ___ they get less physical exercise.
mcq.w: + mệnh đề → This means that.

mcq.q: Car use has increased sharply. This ___ more air pollution in big cities.
mcq.w: lead to + danh từ.

mcq.q: The new law reduces plastic waste and, ___, protects marine life.
mcq.w: thus = vì vậy, có thể đứng giữa câu.

mcq.q: Fewer people are having children. ___, the population is ageing quickly.
mcq.w: As a consequence = Consequently.

groups.name: in other words · that is · namely · in particular · especially
groups.tip: In other words / That is giải thích lại cho rõ; namely = cụ thể là (nêu tên); in particular / especially = đặc biệt là.

mcq.q: Many teenagers are addicted to their phones. ___, they cannot stop using them even when they want to.
mcq.w: Nói lại cho rõ → In other words.

mcq.q: Two subjects are compulsory, ___ maths and literature.
mcq.w: Nêu đúng tên hai môn đó → namely.

mcq.q: Air pollution harms everyone, ___ young children and old people.
mcq.w: Đặc biệt là nhóm nào → especially.

mcq.q: Some countries, ___ Finland, have excellent school systems.
mcq.w: in particular = đặc biệt là (nêu nổi bật).

mcq.q: The company wants to "go green" — ___, it wants to reduce its impact on the environment.
mcq.w: that is = nghĩa là.

groups.name: not only … but also · as well as · apart from · likewise
groups.tip: Not only … but also nối hai ý (ý sau mạnh hơn); apart from + danh từ / V-ing = ngoài … ra; Likewise = Similarly.

mcq.q: Exercise is not only good for the body ___ for the mind.
mcq.w: not only … but also.

mcq.q: ___ being cheap, the bus is also fast.
mcq.w: + V-ing → Apart from.

mcq.q: Students need to manage their time well. ___, workers need to plan their day carefully.
mcq.w: Ý tương tự → Likewise.

mcq.q: Not only ___ the internet faster, but it is also cheaper.
mcq.w: Not only đứng đầu câu → đảo ngữ: Not only is the internet…

mcq.q: The project will create jobs ___ improving local roads.
mcq.w: as well as + V-ing nối trong câu.

groups.name: in order to · so as to · so that
groups.tip: in order to / so as to + V nguyên mẫu (để); so that + mệnh đề (thường có can / could / will). Phủ định: in order not to / so as not to.

mcq.q: Many students work part-time ___ pay for their studies.
mcq.w: + V nguyên mẫu → in order to.

mcq.q: She saved money ___ she could travel to Japan.
mcq.w: + mệnh đề có could → so that.

mcq.q: We left early ___ miss the train.
mcq.w: Phủ định của so as to → so as not to.

mcq.q: The government built more bike lanes ___ people would drive less.
mcq.w: + mệnh đề → so that.

mcq.q: You should write a plan first ___ organise your ideas.
mcq.w: + V nguyên mẫu → in order to.

groups.name: Nối câu cấp 4 (văn viết)
groups.tip: Câu học thuật: từ nối đầu câu + dấu phẩy, hoặc dấu chấm phẩy trước từ nối.

en: Online shopping is convenient. Nevertheless, customers cannot touch the products.
Online shopping is convenient; nevertheless, customers cannot touch the products.

join.b: The air in the city is cleaner.
en: Fewer people use cars. Consequently, the air in the city is cleaner.
Fewer people use cars; consequently, the air in the city is cleaner.
Reading not only improves vocabulary but also reduces stress.
Not only does reading improve vocabulary, but it also reduces stress.
join.w: not only + V … but also + V.

join.b: They want to get better jobs.
en: Many people learn English in order to get better jobs.
join.w: in order to + V nguyên mẫu (bỏ "they want").

join.b: More people would use public transport.
en: The government lowered bus fares so that more people would use public transport.

join.b: Factory and office jobs are disappearing.
en: Some jobs are disappearing, in particular factory and office jobs.
Some jobs are disappearing, factory and office jobs in particular.

join.b: They feel worried and cannot sleep.
en: Many students feel stressed. In other words, they feel worried and cannot sleep.
join.w: In other words giải thích lại.

join.b: Tourism brings money to local businesses.
en: Apart from creating jobs, tourism brings money to local businesses.

join.b: It is a useful tool for learning.
en: Admittedly, technology can be distracting. However, it is a useful tool for learning.
Admittedly, technology can be distracting; however, it is a useful tool for learning.
join.w: Admittedly … However: thừa nhận rồi phản bác.

fix.wrong: In conclusion, firstly, there are many benefits.
en: Firstly, there are many benefits.
In conclusion, there are many benefits.
fix.w: Không dùng In conclusion và Firstly cùng lúc: một cái mở ý đầu, một cái mở đoạn kết.

fix.wrong: At last, I will discuss the disadvantages.
en: Finally, I will discuss the disadvantages.
Lastly, I will discuss the disadvantages.
fix.w: Liệt kê ý cuối dùng Finally / Lastly; At last = cuối cùng thì (sau khi chờ đợi).

fix.wrong: Not only the bus is cheap but also fast.
en: The bus is not only cheap but also fast.
Not only is the bus cheap, but it is also fast.
fix.w: not only … but also nối hai thành phần cùng loại (cheap / fast); đầu câu thì phải đảo ngữ.

fix.wrong: People work hard in order to they can buy a house.
en: People work hard in order to buy a house.
People work hard so that they can buy a house.
fix.w: in order to + V; so that + mệnh đề.

fix.wrong: Nevertheless the cost, many families choose private schools.
en: Despite the cost, many families choose private schools.
The cost is high. Nevertheless, many families choose private schools.
fix.w: Nevertheless không đi với danh từ; với danh từ dùng Despite.

fix.wrong: Many factories closed, consequently many people lost their jobs.
en: Many factories closed; consequently, many people lost their jobs.
Many factories closed. Consequently, many people lost their jobs.
Many factories closed, so many people lost their jobs.
fix.w: Consequently không nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy.

fix.wrong: In the other words, the plan failed.
en: In other words, the plan failed.
fix.w: Cụm cố định: In other words (không có "the").

fix.wrong: On the other hands, cities are crowded.
en: On the other hand, cities are crowded.
fix.w: Cụm cố định: On the other hand (hand số ít).

fix.wrong: This leads to people drive less.
en: This leads to people driving less.
This means that people drive less.
fix.w: lead to + danh từ / V-ing; This means that + mệnh đề.

fix.wrong: Especially, children need more sleep than adults.
en: Children, in particular, need more sleep than adults.
Children especially need more sleep than adults.
In particular, children need more sleep than adults.
fix.w: Especially thường không đứng đầu câu với dấu phẩy; dùng In particular, hoặc đặt especially sau chủ ngữ.
